preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 6 and 200000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly four integers representing two pairs of vertices.

postconditions.expression: any((x1, y1) != (x2, y2) and (x1, y1) != (y2, x2) and (x2, y2) != (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) != (y1, x1) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in zip(*[map(int, stdout.split())]*4))
postconditions.description: The chosen pairs of vertices must be distinct and not share any common vertices.

postconditions.expression: any(len(set(path1) & set(path2)) >= 2 for path1, path2 in [(path_from(x1, y1), path_from(x2, y2)) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in zip(*[map(int, stdout.split())]*4)])
postconditions.description: The paths from the chosen pairs must have at least two common vertices.
